blocks.text: Top Reasons to Seek Help For Drug Addiction
blocks.html: Top Reasons to Seek Help For Drug Addiction

blocks.text: Stories about the perils of drug addiction often focus on the immediate effects: incarceration, conflict with loved ones, financial problems. But drug addiction is a serious, chronic, and potentially life-threatening disease.
blocks.html: Stories about the perils of drug addiction often focus on the immediate effects: incarceration, conflict with loved ones, financial problems. But drug addiction is a serious, chronic, and potentially life-threatening disease.

blocks.text: The effects of drug addiction are far-reaching and pernicious, and not all can be reversed—even when you seek treatment.
blocks.html: The effects of drug addiction are far-reaching and pernicious, and not all can be reversed—even when you seek treatment.

blocks.text: By pursuing help for drug addiction now, you minimize your risk of incurring some of the worst effects of drug addiction. And of course, prompt help can aid you in reversing some of the most dangerous effects of chronic drug use.
blocks.html: By pursuing help for drug addiction now, you minimize your risk of incurring some of the worst effects of drug addiction. And of course, prompt help can aid you in reversing some of the most dangerous effects of chronic drug use.

links.text: most dangerous effects of chronic drug use

blocks.text: Drugs seep into every pore, tissue, and organ of your body, slowly and steadily altering the way your body functions. That whole-body high you feel today could easily become a chronic health problem tomorrow. Help with drug addiction can help you fend off some of the worst side effects, though. Some of the health effects of drug use include:

blocks.text: Drugs affect your brain perhaps before they affect any other area of your body; indeed, the pleasant brain sensations drugs produce are the reason many users become addicted. By seeking help for drug addiction now, you can minimize the extent to which your use of drugs undermines your mental health. Some of the most common psychological side effects of drug use include:

blocks.text: The Social Toll of Drug Use
blocks.html: The Social Toll of Drug Use

blocks.text: Drug use doesn’t just affect your life. It also undermines the very fabric of society. A few of the social ills your drug use contributes to include:
blocks.html: Drug use doesn’t just affect your life. It also undermines the very fabric of society. A few of the social ills your drug use contributes to include:

items.text: Poppies, which help make heroin and other opioids, are a leading cash crop for terrorist organizations such as Al Qaeda and ISIL/ISIS.
items.html: Poppies, which help make heroin and other opioids, are a leading cash crop for terrorist organizations such as Al Qaeda and ISIL/ISIS.

items.text: Organized crime. Drug cartels engage in murders for hire, kidnappings, and a host of other crimes.
items.html: Organized crime. Drug cartels engage in murders for hire, kidnappings, and a host of other crimes.

items.text: Illegal immigration. The cross-national drug trade contributes to illegal immigration, which may endanger illegal immigrants.
items.html: Illegal immigration. The cross-national drug trade contributes to illegal immigration, which may endanger illegal immigrants.

items.text: Gang activity. Violence, theft, and other crimes are part of the everyday life of gangs.
items.html: Gang activity. Violence, theft, and other crimes are part of the everyday life of gangs.

items.text: Medical issues. Doctors who sell their patients drugs or who feed their patients’ drug addiction undermine public trust in medicine.
items.html: Medical issues. Doctors who sell their patients drugs or who feed their patients’ drug addiction undermine public trust in medicine.

items.text: A massive economic drain; addiction robs the economy of about $500 billion each year.
items.html: A massive economic drain; addiction robs the economy of about $500 billion each year.

blocks.text: No matter how hard you try to conceal your addiction, family and friends will notice. And it’s likely that they’ll also suffer. Addiction is an inherently selfish condition, that causes you to behave in ways you’d never dream of if you were sober. The desperate drive for drugs and alcohol can only be quelled with help for drug addiction. If you don’t seek help, some of the consequences include:
